description: This file implements the operations of an HTTP Web client transaction object, including functions to check if it is the last transaction, perform the last transaction, open and close sessions, and manage access control. It appears to be part of an HTTP client component within a broader system, providing session management and transaction handling functionalities.

methods.name: BOOL HttpWctoIsLastTrans(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Checks if the current transaction is the last one by returning the 'bLastTrans' flag from the transaction object.

methods.name: BOOL HttpWctoDoLastTrans(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Determines whether the current transaction is the last based on HTTP version and connection close flags of request and response objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoOpen(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes session activities by acquiring and setting up request and response objects, their interfaces, transaction IDs, and client address info.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoClose(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up session activities by releasing request and response objects and resetting internal references.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoAcquireAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Acquires a lock to gain exclusive access to the transaction object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpWctoReleaseAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Releases the previously acquired lock to allow other operations to access the transaction object.
